name: Havas NV
px_note: SOURCING PRICE BADLY STALE: batch-2 carried 16.31 as_of 07-28; live 18.60 (-0.5% today), 52w high 20.10, +45% off the 12.83 low. The 'upper-third of range' caveat is now 'near the high'.
verdict: PASS at spot / WATCH band (court 2026-07-29, two-mode): the spin-orphan discount has largely re-rated away (~10x now vs ~9x at the STALE sourcing price on a lower tape). H1 (Jul-23): organic +2.5%, adj-EBIT margin up, guide-midpoint - solid mid-pack (Publicis RAISED, WPP broke; Havas sits between). Bollore at 53% and CREEPING (Etoile des Mers to ~22% Feb-26). COURT CORRECTION to the sourcing: the AMF-Lagardere squeeze precedent does NOT protect here - Havas NV is DUTCH (AMS-listed NV): squeeze-out runs through the Enterprise Chamber at 95%, a different and largely untested protection regime for this setup. The remaining bull case is 'Bollore eventually tenders at a premium' - event-carry where the CONTROLLER sets the price and the clock. That is optionality you can wait to be paid for at a lower entry; at 18.60 you pay for it.
fv_note: base ~10.5x ~EUR1.80 adj EPS; bear = agency fee-compression (the WPP path) 7x; bull = Bollore tender at a 20-30% premium
entry_band: re-open <EUR16 (~8.5-9x, lower-third of range) - VALUATION gate, single-condition. Separately (pack, any price): a Bollore tender/offer FILING = evaluate the offer terms fresh (never pre-commit to tender into a controller's price).
reaction_driver: the stock trades on Bollore filings (creep %, offer) + organic vs the Publicis/Omnicom prints, NOT on its own quarter alone
kill_triggers: organic negative while Publicis positive (share loss)
Bollore creep >60% without an offer (the slow-squeeze path compresses the minority's exit)
